verdict.rationale: First-party docs confirm Authenticator generates one-time password codes, works offline, and supports non-Microsoft accounts such as Amazon and Google. The pack has no first-party documentation of the QR-scan enrollment flow itself; the QR references are about downloading the app or Verified IDs. One hands-on report describes a known QR-add issue that the user avoided by adding the account manually. missing for 10: documented QR-scan-to-add-account flow for TOTP, evidence that enrollment works immediately and reliably, independent corroboration of the scan-to-code flow working.

support.subject: As an everyday user, I can scan a QR code and immediately start generating TOTP codes for a new account

citations.quote: non-Microsoft accounts, such as Amazon, Facebook, Instagram and Google
by using a one-time password code to increase account security
The codes don't require you to be on the internet or connected to data
